controls.name: tv-screen
controls.title: TV screen
controls.description: A screen that broadcasts one video or sound: every viewer plays from where the broadcast is now, by the service's clock, whatever their device clock says. Who may change it chooses the video, starts and pauses the broadcast and makes their own position the broadcast's; a viewer's own pause and mute stay on their device.

catalog.description: Everyone watches the same video at the same moment

controls.name: time-limited
controls.title: Visible for a while
controls.description: Shows the Blocks put in it to each viewer for a while from the first time that viewer opened it, with the time left; then they are hidden for that viewer. A presentation, not access control: the shared document does not change, design mode shows everything marked, prints and exports show everything.

catalog.description: Each viewer sees it for a while after opening

controls.name: photo-vote
controls.title: Photo vote
controls.description: Everyone picks a few photos of a bound folder; the cover shows the photos with the most votes. Each person has one choice of their own (at most `picks` photos), can change it and can change only theirs — the vote table's submitter field is filled by the service. The cover is computed by whoever looks, never written back.

catalog.description: Pick photos; the cover shows the favourites

controls.name: listen-together
controls.title: Listen together
controls.description: Plays a folder of audio for everyone at the same moment: the owner starts, pauses and skips from the toolbar (no need to start the control first), listeners follow by the service's clock, with a running waveform and the lyrics of a song that has a .lrc file of the same name. Anyone can listen on their own for a while; their volume and their own position are kept for them.

catalog.description: A playlist everyone hears at the same moment
